name: 99 - SYSTEM - Tự động dọn rác & Tối ưu Database Supabase

nodes.name: Bấm dọn rác thủ công ngay

parameters.query:
-- 1. Dọn dẹp Chunk Embedding mồ côi
WITH orphaned_emb AS (
  DELETE FROM legal_chunk_embeddings e
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legal_document_chunks c WHERE c.id = e.chunk_id
  )
  RETURNING id
),
-- 2. Dọn dẹp Chunk của các phiên bản tài liệu không hoàn tất cũ hơn 24h
stale_versions AS (
  SELECT id FROM legal_document_versions
  WHERE is_current = false AND created_at < now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM legal_ingestion_runs r WHERE r.document_version_id = legal_document_versions.id AND r.status = 'completed'
    )
),
stale_chunks AS (
  DELETE FROM legal_document_chunks c
  USING stale_versions v
  WHERE c.document_version_id = v.id
  RETURNING c.id
),
stale_vers_del AS (
  DELETE FROM legal_document_versions v
  USING stale_versions sv
  WHERE v.id = sv.id
  RETURNING v.id
),
-- 3. Dọn dẹp tin nhắn rỗng nội dung
empty_msgs AS (
  DELETE FROM conversation_messages
  WHERE (content IS NULL OR trim(content) = '')
    AND (attachments IS NULL OR attachments = '[]'::jsonb)
  RETURNING id
),
-- 4. Dọn dẹp hội thoại không có bất kỳ tin nhắn nào (cũ hơn 14 ngày)
empty_convs AS (
  DELETE FROM conversations c
  WHERE c.created_at < now() - INTERVAL '14 days'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM conversation_messages m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id
    )
  RETURNING id
),
-- 5. Dọn dẹp Lead rác hoàn toàn không có thông tin
empty_leads AS (
  DELETE FROM leads
  WHERE full_name IS NULL
    AND phone IS NULL
    AND email IS NULL
    AND need IS NULL
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM orphaned_emb) AS deleted_orphaned_embeddings,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stale_chunks) AS deleted_stale_chunks,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM stale_vers_del) AS deleted_stale_versions,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM empty_msgs) AS deleted_empty_messages,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM empty_convs) AS deleted_empty_conversations,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM empty_leads) AS deleted_empty_leads;
